data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER closed_entry_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON attendance_entries
WHEN (OLD.work_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) OR NEW.work_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened))
  AND (NEW.clock_minutes <> OLD.clock_minutes OR NEW.break_minutes <> OLD.break_minutes
    OR NEW.client_billable_minutes <> OLD.client_billable_minutes OR NEW.worker_payable_minutes <> OLD.worker_payable_minutes
    OR NEW.client_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.client_rate_fils OR NEW.client_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.client_amount_fils
    OR NEW.worker_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_rate_fils OR NEW.worker_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_amount_fils
    OR NEW.worker_id <> OLD.worker_id OR NEW.client_id <> OLD.client_id OR NEW.site_id <> OLD.site_id
    OR NEW.work_date <> OLD.work_date OR NEW.superseded <> OLD.superseded OR NEW.attendance_status <> OLD.attendance_status)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'period is closed');
END;

data.name: approved_entry_no_edit
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER approved_entry_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON attendance_entries
WHEN OLD.state IN ('approved', 'linked')
  AND (NEW.clock_minutes <> OLD.clock_minutes OR NEW.break_minutes <> OLD.break_minutes
    OR (OLD.client_rate_fils IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.client_billable_minutes <> OLD.client_billable_minutes
      OR NEW.client_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.client_rate_fils OR NEW.client_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.client_amount_fils))
    OR NEW.worker_payable_minutes <> OLD.worker_payable_minutes
    OR NEW.worker_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_rate_fils OR NEW.worker_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_amount_fils
    OR NEW.worker_id <> OLD.worker_id OR NEW.work_date <> OLD.work_date)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'approved attendance is immutable');
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'audit events are append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'audit events are append-only');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rooms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "trade" TEXT NULL, "joining_date" TEXT NULL, "room_charge_fils" INTEGER NULL, "room_charge_note" TEXT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id), "visa_instalment_fils" INTEGER NULL CHECK("visa_instalment_fils" > 0), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("tenant_id", "code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "contact_person" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "vat_registered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("vat_registered" IN (0, 1)), "trn" TEXT NULL, "invoice_address" TEXT NULL, "due_days" INTEGER NULL, "po_reference" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sites" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "contact" TEXT NULL, "active_from" TEXT NULL, "active_to" TEXT NULL, "default_start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "default_end_minute" INTEGER NULL, "default_break_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_fils" > 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "worker_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "room_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id), "client_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "category" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "note" TEXT NULL, "reverses_entry_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES cash_entries (id), "reference" TEXT NULL, "receiver" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind NOT IN ('advanceGiven', 'salaryPaid', 'advanceReturned') OR worker_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (kind NOT IN ('roomRentPaid', 'roomRentReceived') OR room_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (kind <> 'clientReceipt' OR client_id IS NOT NULL));
CREATE TRIGGER cash_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON cash_entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'cash entries are append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER cash_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON cash_entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'cash entries are append-only');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "salary_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cash_entries (id), "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_fils" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("payment_id", "month"));
CREATE TRIGGER allocation_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON salary_allocations BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'salary allocations are append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER allocation_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON salary_allocations BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'salary allocations are append-only');END

CREATE TRIGGER cash_visa_needs_worker BEFORE INSERT ON cash_entries WHEN NEW.kind IN ('visaPaid', 'visaReturned') AND NEW.worker_id IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a visa line needs a worker');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_to" TEXT NOT NULL, "posting_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER payroll_run_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON payroll_runs BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'posted payroll is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER payroll_run_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payroll_runs BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'posted payroll is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_runs (id), "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "period_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "earned_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "salary_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "adjustment_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "allowances_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deductions_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recovery_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "visa_recovery_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "net_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payable_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_before_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reversed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reversed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER payroll_line_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE OF run_id, worker_id, period_from, opening_fils, earned_fils, salary_fils, adjustment_fils, allowances_fils, deductions_fils, recovery_fils, visa_recovery_fils, net_fils, payable_fils, paid_before_fils ON payroll_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'posted payroll is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER payroll_line_stays_reversed BEFORE UPDATE OF reversed ON payroll_lines WHEN OLD.reversed BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a reversed payroll line stays reversed');END
CREATE TRIGGER payroll_line_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payroll_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'posted payroll is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "period_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_fils" > 0), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "authorized_by" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id), "line_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payroll_lines (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind NOT IN ('deduction', 'roomCharge') OR authorized_by IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TRIGGER posted_item_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE OF worker_id, period_from, kind, amount_fils, reason, authorized_by, room_id ON payroll_items WHEN OLD.line_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a posted payroll item is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER posted_item_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payroll_items WHEN OLD.line_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a posted payroll item is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "period_locks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "reopened" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reopened" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER lock_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON period_locks BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a period lock stays on record');END
CREATE TRIGGER lock_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE OF month, last_day ON period_locks BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a period lock stays on record');END
CREATE TRIGGER lock_stays_reopened BEFORE UPDATE OF reopened ON period_locks WHEN OLD.reopened BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a reopened lock stays reopened');END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_live_period_lock ON period_locks (month) WHERE NOT reopened

CREATE TRIGGER closed_cash_no_insert BEFORE INSERT ON cash_entries WHEN NEW.entry_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "issued_documents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "number" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "identity_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "meta_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "pdf_bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("tenant_id", "kind", "year", "seq", "revision"));
CREATE TRIGGER issued_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON issued_documents BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an issued document never changes');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON issued_documents BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an issued document stays on record');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document_assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "width_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_px" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER asset_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON document_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a stored image never changes');END
CREATE TRIGGER asset_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON document_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a stored image stays on record');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_offs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "work_date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("tenant_id", "worker_id", "work_date"));
CREATE TRIGGER closed_day_off_no_insert BEFORE INSERT ON day_offs WHEN NEW.work_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "worker_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "daily_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL CHECK("daily_rate_fils" >= 0), "half_day_is_half" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("half_day_is_half" IN (0, 1)), "start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NULL, "break_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "group_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES worker_groups (id), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_batches (id), "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "group_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES worker_groups (id), "work_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc" INTEGER NULL, "end_utc" INTEGER NULL, "clock_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("clock_minutes" >= 0), "break_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("break_minutes" >= 0), "break_paid_client" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("break_paid_client" IN (0, 1)), "break_paid_worker" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("break_paid_worker" IN (0, 1)), "client_billable_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "worker_payable_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "overtime_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "overtime_approved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("overtime_approved" IN (0, 1)), "attendance_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "client_ack" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "client_basis" TEXT NULL, "client_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL, "client_amount_fils" INTEGER NULL, "worker_basis" TEXT NULL, "worker_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL, "worker_amount_fils" INTEGER NULL, "client_rate_override_fils" INTEGER NULL, "worker_rate_override_fils" INTEGER NULL, "override_reason" TEXT NULL, "overlap_reason" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "revises_entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES attendance_entries (id), "superseded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("superseded" IN (0, 1)), "payroll_line_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payroll_lines (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (break_minutes <= clock_minutes));

CREATE TRIGGER closed_entry_no_insert BEFORE INSERT ON attendance_entries WHEN NEW.work_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TRIGGER closed_entry_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON attendance_entries WHEN(OLD.work_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) OR NEW.work_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened))AND(NEW.clock_minutes <> OLD.clock_minutes OR NEW.break_minutes <> OLD.break_minutes OR NEW.client_billable_minutes <> OLD.client_billable_minutes OR NEW.worker_payable_minutes <> OLD.worker_payable_minutes OR NEW.client_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.client_rate_fils OR NEW.client_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.client_amount_fils OR NEW.worker_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_rate_fils OR NEW.worker_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_amount_fils OR NEW.worker_id <> OLD.worker_id OR NEW.client_id <> OLD.client_id OR NEW.site_id <> OLD.site_id OR NEW.work_date <> OLD.work_date OR NEW.superseded <> OLD.superseded OR NEW.attendance_status <> OLD.attendance_status)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TRIGGER closed_entry_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON attendance_entries WHEN OLD.work_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TRIGGER closed_item_no_insert BEFORE INSERT ON payroll_items WHEN NEW.period_from <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TRIGGER closed_item_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON payroll_items WHEN OLD.period_from <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) OR NEW.period_from <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TRIGGER closed_item_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payroll_items WHEN OLD.period_from <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TRIGGER closed_line_no_insert BEFORE INSERT ON payroll_lines WHEN NEW.period_from <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TRIGGER closed_line_no_reverse BEFORE UPDATE OF reversed ON payroll_lines WHEN OLD.period_from <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "opening_balances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "client_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "amount_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_fils" >= 0), "as_of_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_note" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("kind", "worker_id"), UNIQUE ("kind", "client_id"), CHECK ((worker_id IS NULL) <> (client_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TRIGGER closed_opening_no_insert BEFORE INSERT ON opening_balances WHEN NEW.as_of_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END

CREATE TRIGGER closed_opening_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON opening_balances WHEN OLD.as_of_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) OR NEW.as_of_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM period_locks WHERE NOT reopened) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'period is closed');END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_live_payroll_line ON payroll_lines (worker_id, period_from) WHERE NOT reversed

CREATE TRIGGER approved_entry_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE ON attendance_entries WHEN OLD.state IN ('approved', 'linked') AND(NEW.clock_minutes <> OLD.clock_minutes OR NEW.break_minutes <> OLD.break_minutes OR(OLD.client_rate_fils IS NOT NULL AND(NEW.client_billable_minutes <> OLD.client_billable_minutes OR NEW.client_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.client_rate_fils OR NEW.client_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.client_amount_fils))OR NEW.worker_payable_minutes <> OLD.worker_payable_minutes OR NEW.worker_rate_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_rate_fils OR NEW.worker_amount_fils IS NOT OLD.worker_amount_fils OR NEW.worker_id <> OLD.worker_id OR NEW.work_date <> OLD.work_date)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'approved attendance is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER linked_entry_keeps_state BEFORE UPDATE ON attendance_entries WHEN OLD.state = 'linked' AND NEW.state <> 'linked' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'linked attendance is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER entry_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON attendance_entries WHEN OLD.state NOT IN ('draft', 'submitted') BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'approved attendance cannot be deleted');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timesheets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "from_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "seq" INTEGER NULL, "number" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("tenant_id", "year", "seq"));

CREATE TRIGGER timesheet_keeps_number BEFORE UPDATE OF client_id, site_id, from_date, to_date, year, seq, number ON timesheets WHEN OLD.number IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an approved timesheet keeps its number and dates');END
CREATE TRIGGER timesheet_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON timesheets WHEN OLD.number IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an approved timesheet stays on record');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timesheet_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "timesheet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES timesheets (id), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "reason" TEXT NULL, "adjustments" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "shared_on" TEXT NULL, "responded_on" TEXT NULL, "response_note" TEXT NULL, "evidence_asset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES document_assets (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("timesheet_id", "revision"));

CREATE TRIGGER revision_no_redraft BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON timesheet_revisions WHEN OLD.status <> 'draft' AND NEW.status = 'draft' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an approved revision stays approved');END

CREATE TRIGGER revision_keeps_adjustments BEFORE UPDATE OF timesheet_id, revision, adjustments ON timesheet_revisions WHEN OLD.status <> 'draft' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an approved revision never changes');END
CREATE TRIGGER revision_accepted_locked BEFORE UPDATE ON timesheet_revisions WHEN OLD.status = 'accepted' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an accepted revision is locked');END
CREATE TRIGGER revision_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON timesheet_revisions WHEN OLD.status <> 'draft' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an approved revision stays on record');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timesheet_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "timesheet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES timesheets (id), "revision_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES timesheet_revisions (id), "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendance_entries (id), "work_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "site_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "worker_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "trade" TEXT NULL, "attendance_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "clock_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "break_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "billable_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_fils" INTEGER NULL CHECK("amount_fils" >= 0), "adjust_reason" TEXT NULL, "live" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("live" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER timesheet_line_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE OF timesheet_id, revision_id, entry_id, work_key, work_date, site_id, site_name, worker_id, worker_name, worker_code, trade, attendance_status, clock_minutes, break_minutes, billable_minutes, basis, rate_fils, amount_fils, adjust_reason ON timesheet_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an approved timesheet line never changes');END
CREATE TRIGGER timesheet_line_stays_off BEFORE UPDATE OF live ON timesheet_lines WHEN NOT OLD.live AND NEW.live BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a replaced timesheet line stays replaced');END
CREATE TRIGGER timesheet_line_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON timesheet_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'an approved timesheet line stays on record');END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_live_timesheet_line ON timesheet_lines (work_key) WHERE live

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "billed_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES timesheet_lines (id), "work_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_fils" >= 0), "released" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("released" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER billing_no_edit BEFORE UPDATE OF line_id, work_key, invoice_id, amount_fils ON billed_allocations BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a billed allocation never changes');END
CREATE TRIGGER billing_stays_released BEFORE UPDATE OF released ON billed_allocations WHEN OLD.released BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a released allocation stays released');END
CREATE TRIGGER billing_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON billed_allocations BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a billed allocation stays on record');END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_live_billing ON billed_allocations (work_key) WHERE NOT released

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tenant_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "legal_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "trading_name" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "vat_registered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("vat_registered" IN (0, 1)), "vat_effective_from" TEXT NULL, "trn" TEXT NULL, "invoice_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INV', "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "payment_terms_days" INTEGER NULL, "bank_details" TEXT NULL, "document_footer" TEXT NULL, "deduction_limit_bps" INTEGER NULL, "wage_due_days" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pay_contracts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("rate_fils" >= 0), "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_to" TEXT NULL, "break_paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("break_paid" IN (0, 1)), "half_amount_fils" INTEGER NULL, "included_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "overtime_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "site_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "partial_method" TEXT NULL, "partial_divisor" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "billing_contracts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_fils" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("rate_fils" >= 0), "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_to" TEXT NULL, "break_paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("break_paid" IN (0, 1)), "half_amount_fils" INTEGER NULL, "included_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "overtime_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "site_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sites (id), "worker_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "worker_group_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worker_groups (id), "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers (id), "daily_rate_fils" INTEGER NULL CHECK("daily_rate_fils" >= 0), "rate_basis" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'day', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("group_id", "worker_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "logo_asset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES document_assets (id), "header_asset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES document_assets (id), "footer_asset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES document_assets (id), "signature_asset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES document_assets (id), "stamp_asset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES document_assets (id), "placements" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "print_letterhead" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("print_letterhead" IN (0, 1)), "blank_top_mm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 40, "blank_bottom_mm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 25, "show_signature" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_signature" IN (0, 1)), "show_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_stamp" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "acked_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"));
